title: Peloton Passed Planet Fitness And Stayed Ahead
hook: The Bike That Out-Earned The Gym
source: Peloton Interactive annual revenue from company 10-K/SEC filings, fiscal year: $0.219B (2017), $0.435B (2018), $0.915B (2019), $1.83B (2020), $4.02B (2021), $3.58B (2022), $2.80B (2023), $2.70B (2024). Planet Fitness Inc annual revenue from company 10-K/SEC filings: $0.430B (2017), $0.573B (2018), $0.689B (2019), $0.407B (2020, pandemic gym closures), $0.587B (2021), $0.937B (2022), $1.07B (2023), $1.18B (2024). Peloton's at-home fitness boom pushed its revenue past Planet Fitness's in 2019, a year before the pandemic supercharged it further; even after its post-pandemic crash, Peloton's revenue never fell back below Planet Fitness's.
